DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have the notice with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。名前は世帯主ですが、私は同じ世帯の家族です。何を確認できるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 世帯主宛通知を家族が相談できる範囲を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It is addressed to the head of the household, but I am a family member in the same household. I would like to ask what I can have checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask what a family member may discuss about a notice addressed to the head of the household. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人の名前の通知ではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: So the notice is not in your own name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうです。世帯主になりすまして説明を受けたいわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人宛でなく世帯主として振舞わないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's right. I am not trying to receive an explanation by pretending to be the head of the household.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it is not addressed to you and that you are not acting as the head of the household. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 相談できる範囲と資料を担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check with the person in charge about what you can discuss and the documents needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。まず通知の種類と、世帯主本人の確認が必要な部分を分けて知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一般説明と本人確認要部分を分けて聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. First, I would like to know the type of notice and, separately, which parts require confirmation from the head of the household personally.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask separately about general explanations and matters requiring the addressee's identity to be confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 世帯主とは連絡できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can you contact the head of the household?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: できます。本人からの確認が必要なら、ここで勝手に答えず本人へつなぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 連絡可能で本人確認は本人へつなぐと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. If confirmation from them is needed, I will put you in touch with them rather than answer here without their permission.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you can contact them and will refer personal confirmation to them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご自身の資料はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you have your own documents with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。この資料です。来た人は私、通知の宛名は世帯主と分けて受付してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自身資料で来訪者と宛名を分けて受付依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, these are my documents. Please register me as the visitor and the head of the household as the notice's addressee, keeping the two separate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Use your own documents and ask for the visitor and addressee to be registered separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 通知とご自身の資料を確認します。説明できる範囲を担当からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check the notice and your own documents. The person in charge will explain what information we can provide.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 結果の用紙をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have the results sheet with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。会社の健康診断の結果です。ここで診断されたものではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社健診結果で当院診断ではないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. These are the results of a health check at my company. They are not a diagnosis made at this hospital.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that these are company health check results, not a diagnosis from this hospital. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの項目をご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which item would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この印のある項目です。印があるだけで病名が決まったとは理解していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 対象印と病名未確定を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: This marked item. I do not understand the mark alone to mean that a specific disease has been diagnosed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain which marked item you mean and that no disease has been confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 結果を担当へお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please show the results to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。健診を受けた日と、今の症状の有無も別に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 健診日と現在症状を別報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I will report the date of the health check and whether I have any symptoms now as separate points.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report the health check date and current symptoms separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今、気になる症状はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have any symptoms that concern you now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 特に感じていません。ただ、症状がないから結果を無視してよいとも決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自覚症状なしでも結果を無視しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I haven't noticed any in particular. Still, I won't conclude that I can ignore the results simply because I have no symptoms.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that even without noticeable symptoms you will not ignore the results. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: これまでの結果もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you also have your previous results?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 去年の分もあります。二年分を並べ、診察で必要な確認を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 昨年今年の二結果を比較相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have last year's too. I will put the two years' results side by side and discuss what needs checking during the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to compare and discuss last year's and this year's two sets of results. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 健診結果の相談として受け付けます。二年分の資料を担当へお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will register this as a consultation about health check results. Please show both years' documents to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: なくした時刻は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you know what time you lost it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 正確には分かりません。でも最後に財布を使った店のレシートがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 不明な紛失時刻をレシートで絞れると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I don't know exactly. But I have a receipt from the last shop where I used my wallet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the receipt can narrow down the unknown time of the loss. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その時刻を確認できますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 午後二時十分です。財布がないと気づいたのは三時なので、その間に絞れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最終使用と発覚の二時刻を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was 2:10 p.m. I noticed my wallet was missing at three, so we can narrow it down to that interval.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the two times: when you last used it and when you noticed it was missing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その間、どこへ移動しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Where did you go during that time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 店から公園へ歩き、その後バス停にいました。レシートの時刻が紛失時刻とは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 間の経路と支払時刻非紛失時刻を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I walked from the shop to the park and then was at the bus stop. The time on the receipt is not necessarily when I lost it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe your route during that interval and say that the payment time is not necessarily the loss time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 財布の特徴をお願いします。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 茶色で、小さい星の金具があります。最後に使った場所と、気づいた場所を分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 財布特徴と使用発覚場所を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's brown, with a small star-shaped metal fitting. I will explain separately where I last used it and where I noticed it was missing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the wallet and distinguish where you used it from where you noticed the loss. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 経路を地図で示せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Can you show the route on a map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。この道です。記憶のない所は推測で埋めず、分かる経路だけ示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 地図へ記憶ある経路のみ示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, this road. I will only show the route I remember, without filling gaps in my memory with guesses.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show only the route you remember on the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: レシートと地図を担当へお見せください。時間帯と経路を記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please show the receipt and map to the person in charge. We will record the time interval and route.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何をお送りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to send?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分で作った食品です。冷たいまま送りたいので、普通の箱に入れる前に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自作食品の冷蔵発送条件を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Food I made myself. I want to send it chilled, so I would like to ask about it before putting it in a regular box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the conditions for shipping homemade food refrigerated. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 食品の種類と保存の状態を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me what kind of food it is and how it has been stored.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 煮物です。家では冷蔵していますが、こちらへ来る間の温度までは測っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 食品種類保存と持参温度未測定を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's a simmered dish. I keep it refrigerated at home, but I haven't measured its temperature during the journey here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the food type, storage and that its temperature while bringing it here was not measured. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 利用できる方法と取扱い条件を担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the available methods and handling conditions with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。冷蔵配送ならどんな自作食品も安全になるとは考えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 冷蔵配送で安全になると断定しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I do not assume that refrigerated shipping makes every kind of homemade food safe.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you are not claiming refrigerated shipping will make it safe. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 相手へ届けたい日は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you decided when you want it to reach the recipient?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 希望はありますが約束はしていません。条件が合わなければ、今回は送らないことにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 希望日未約束で不適なら発送しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have a preferred date, but I haven't promised it. If the conditions are not suitable, I will decide not to send it this time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that the preferred date is not promised and you will not ship it if the conditions are unsuitable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 梱包についても確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check the packaging requirements.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。食品の状態と包装、利用できる配送を説明で確認してから決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 状態包装配送条件を確認して決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will decide after the explanation has clarified the food's condition, packaging and available delivery options.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will decide after checking the food condition, packaging and delivery conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 内容と状態を担当へお伝えください。発送できるか確認する前に荷物を閉じないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please tell the person in charge about the contents and their condition. Do not close the package before we check whether it can be shipped.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 支払いについてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to ask about payment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 口座にお金を入れました。これで今月の料金は自動で引かれるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 入金だけで自動引落しになるか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I put money in my account. Will this month's charge now be deducted automatically?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether depositing money alone will result in an automatic debit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 引落しの申込みは済んでいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you applied for direct debit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 用紙は出しましたが、登録完了の連絡はまだ見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 申込書提出済み登録完了未確認を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I submitted the form, but I haven't seen a notification confirming that registration is complete yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you submitted the application but have not confirmed completion of registration. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 登録状況は請求先の案内も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also check the biller's instructions about the registration status.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。残高があることと、登録が終わったことは別ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 残高と登録完了を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand. Having a balance and having completed registration are separate things.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish between having a balance and completed registration. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今月の請求書は届いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you received this month's bill?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 届いています。振込用紙もあるので、今月の支払方法を請求先へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 請求書振込紙で今月方法を先へ確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. There is also a bank transfer slip, so I will check with the biller how to pay this month.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Use the bill and transfer slip to check this month's payment method with the biller. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二重に払わないよう、対象の月も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's also check which month the payment is for, to avoid paying twice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。登録状況、対象月、今回の支払い方を整理してから手続きをします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 登録対象月と支払方法を整理し二重払いを避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will sort out the registration status, the applicable month and how to make this payment before proceeding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Clarify registration, the applicable month and payment method to avoid paying twice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 口座の記録は確認できます。今月の指定方法は請求先へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We can check the account records. Please ask the biller which method is specified for this month.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのお惣菜をご覧ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking at these prepared dishes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人分買います。一つは子ども用なので、辛さの表示を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人分で子ども用の辛さ確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm buying for two people. One is for a child, so I would like to check the spiciness label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are buying for two and ask to check the spiciness of the child's dish. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらには辛口の印があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This one has a spicy symbol.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では子ども用には選びません。色が薄いから辛くないと判断していました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 色で辛さ判断した誤解を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I won't choose it for the child. I had assumed it wasn't spicy because of its pale color.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct your mistaken judgment of spiciness based on color. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 辛さを付けていない商品もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We also have products without added heat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その商品を見たいです。私の分は辛口、子どもの分は別の商品にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 大人辛口子ども別品を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to see those. I'll choose the spicy one for myself and a different product for the child.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the spicy dish for the adult and another product for the child. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それぞれ一つでよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Would you like one of each?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。袋を分けなくても、商品名のラベルを見て渡せるようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 各一個と品名ラベルで区別希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Even if they aren't put in separate bags, I want to be able to hand them out by checking the product-name labels.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm one of each and say you want to distinguish them by the product-name labels. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二品のラベルはこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here are the labels for the two items.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認しました。家でもラベルを見て分け、見た目だけで入れ替えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家庭でもラベル照合して渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked them. At home too, I will check the labels to tell them apart and avoid swapping them based on appearance alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the labels when handing them out at home too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 辛口と別の商品を一つずつですね。ラベルを付けたままお持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: One spicy dish and one different product, then. Please leave the labels attached when you take them home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 集合写真を撮られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to take a group photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。でも一人は写りたくないと言っています。その人を無理に並ばせずに撮りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 非参加者を無理に写さず撮る希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But one person says they don't want to be in it. We would like to take it without forcing that person to line up with us.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want a photo without forcing the nonparticipant to appear in it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真の外で待てる場所があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is a place where they can wait outside the frame.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そちらで待ってもらいます。参加しない人が一人いても、移動の時は全員で合流します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 非参加者の待機と移動時合流を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: We'll ask them to wait there. Even though one person won't participate, everyone will meet up when we move on.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Arrange where the nonparticipant will wait and that everyone will reunite before moving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: How many people are in your group?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 六人です。写真は五人ですが、散歩へ出る時の人数は六人です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 撮影五人同行六人を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Six. There will be five in the photo, but six when we head out for the walk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the five people in the photo from the six going along. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通路を空けて短く撮ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep the passage clear and take the photo quickly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。撮る人も端に寄り、待っている友人の顔を背景へ入れないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通路を空け非参加者の背景映りを避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. The photographer will stand to the side too, and we'll avoid including our waiting friend's face in the background.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Keep the passage clear and avoid including the nonparticipant in the background. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 公開するかも皆様で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check with everyone whether the photo may be made public.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そうします。撮れたことだけで公開に同意したと思わず、五人に共有範囲を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 撮影と公開同意を分け共有範囲を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: We will. We won't assume that being photographed means agreeing to publication; we'll ask the five people how widely it may be shared.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish consent to photography from publication and ask about the sharing scope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 横の広場をお使いください。撮影後は待っている方とも合流してお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15225-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please use the square to the side. After taking the photo, meet up with the person who is waiting before continuing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。友人と席が離れています。私の荷物を友人が持っているので、乗る前に受け取りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 離れた席の友人から乗車前に荷物を受けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My friend and I have seats apart. My friend has my luggage, so I want to collect it before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to collect your luggage before boarding from a friend seated elsewhere. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are you in the same carriage?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 別の号車です。車内の通路で大きい荷物を渡すと、人の邪魔になりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別号車で車内受渡しは通行を妨げると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, different carriages. Passing large luggage in the aisle inside the train would probably get in people's way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you are in different carriages and handing it over inside would obstruct the aisle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 乗車前にホームの広い場所で合流できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can meet in a spacious part of the platform before boarding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そこへ行きます。友人へ号車の入口ではなく、受渡しする目印を送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ホームの目印で合流を連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll go there. I'll send my friend a landmark for the handover, rather than a carriage entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tell your friend to meet at a landmark on the platform. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 発車までの時間はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have time before departure?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 十分ほどです。荷物の受取が済んだら、各自の号車へ別々に進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 残時間と受取後の各号車移動を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: About ten minutes. Once I have collected my luggage, we will each go separately to our own carriage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State the time remaining and that each person will go to their carriage after the handover. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 荷物の数も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the number of bags too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。鞄一つを受け取り、自分の分を持ってから券の号車を見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 鞄一つの受取と自分の号車を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll collect one bag, make sure I have my own belongings, and then check the carriage number on my ticket again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm collecting one bag and check your own carriage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 通路を空けて受渡しを済ませてください。その後、それぞれの乗車位置でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please keep the passage clear while handing it over. Afterwards, wait at your respective boarding positions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書の相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about a certificate?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもの学校から住所が分かる物を求められました。どの書類を頼むべきか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 学校用住所書類の種類を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child's school has asked for something showing our address. I don't know which document I should request.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask which type of address document is needed for school. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 学校からの案内はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the school's instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この紙です。子どもの名前と住所が必要ですが、世帯の全員を出す指定ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 子どもの必要情報と全世帯指定なしを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: This sheet. They need my child's name and address, but it does not specify including everyone in the household.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the child's required information and that the whole household is not specified. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な項目と書類名を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the required items and the document's name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。家族全員の情報を多く載せればよいとは考えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族情報を多く出すことが正解でないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I don't assume that providing more information about every family member is the right thing to do.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that providing more family information is not necessarily the right answer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 提出の期限はいつですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 来週です。学校へ正式な種類を確認する時間があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 期限と学校確認可能時間を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Next week. I have time to confirm the official document type with the school.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State the deadline and that there is time to check with the school. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 学校の条件が分かれば窓口で案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you know the school's requirements, we can advise you at the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、必要な項目と書類名を学校へ聞き、分かった内容で申請します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 正式種類項目を聞いてから申請する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will ask the school for the required items and document name, and apply based on what I learn.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will apply after asking about the official type and required items. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 案内の紙をお持ちください。用途に合う種類が決まってから申請をご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please bring the instruction sheet. Ask us about applying once the appropriate type for your purpose has been decided.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お薬の説明をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please wait for the explanation about your medicine.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 診察が終わったので、もう会社へ戻れると連絡しそうでした。まだ残る手続きを確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 診察後に残る手続きを質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Since the consultation had finished, I nearly told my company I could already return. I would like to check what procedures remain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask what procedures remain after the consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 薬の説明と会計があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is the medicine explanation and payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。診察終了と病院を出る時刻は同じではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 診察終了と病院退出を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I understand. The end of the consultation and the time I leave the hospital are not the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish finishing the consultation from leaving the hospital. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 会社には今の状況を伝えられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can you tell your company the current situation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。説明待ちと会計が残っていると伝え、今すぐ戻ると約束しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社へ残手続きを伝え即復帰を約束しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'll tell them I'm waiting for the explanation and still need to pay, and won't promise to return immediately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tell your company about the remaining procedures without promising an immediate return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 薬の受取についても確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check how to collect the medicine.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。処方の紙を受け取ることと、薬を手に入れることも分けて考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 処方紙と薬受取を分けて確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I will also distinguish receiving the prescription paper from actually obtaining the medicine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check separately about receiving the prescription and collecting the medicine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当から説明があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。必要な説明を聞き、残る手続きが分かってから会社へ出発時刻を連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 説明後に出発時刻を会社へ連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll listen to the necessary explanations and let my company know my departure time once I understand the remaining procedures.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will inform your company of your departure time after the explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらで説明をお待ちください。会計と受取の案内も順にお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15226-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait here for the explanation. We will also explain payment and collection in order.
